The '''RO/5T.N1 tree feeder''' was a gardening [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufactured by [[Publictechnic]]. The droid was commonly referred to as the '''5T tree feeder''' or even just a '''tree feeder'''.

==Description==
The RO/5T.N1 resembled a gigantic [[Metal/Legends|metal]] [[Spider/Legends|spider]], with six thin [[Limb/Legends|legs]] that connected to the body via dorsal support rods and terminated in [[Shovel/Legends|spade]]-like digger tips. The main body of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] hung down between the legs, with the droid's abdomen consisting of a large [[Water/Legends|water]] tank. An articulated hose with an [[adjustable sprayer nozzle]] protruded from the front of the unit that could dispense the water, or organic [[pesticide]]s and [[Fertilizer/Legends|fertilizers]] as required.<ref name="EGTD" />

Two [[Manipulator arm/Legends|manipulator arms]] protruded from the front of the unit, and a number of other retractable appendages extended from the body, each tipped with a specialist gardening tool. These appendages included an [[edger/trimmer]], [[pruning shears]], a probe that was used to test soil moisture and pH, and specialized arms for weeding and harvesting [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].<ref name="EGTD" />

[[File:5TTreeFeeder.jpg|thumb|left|The aft view of a 5T "Tree Feeder"]]
The RO/5T.N1 featured an array of [[Sensor/Legends|sensory]] nodes and yellow lights around the rim of the body. Two turret-like [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] were mounted at the front of the droid<ref name="EGTD" /> which were capable of zooming in with a high level of magnification to inspect damage to plants that were invisible to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Eye/Legends|eye]]<ref name="FF35" /> such as a seedling's root structure, or damage caused by [[Insect/Legends|insects]].<ref name="EGTD" /> Powerful front-mounted [[Spotlight/Legends|spotlights]] allowed the RO/5T.N1 to work in the dark, providing round-the-clock care.<ref name="FF35" />

Although fearsome looking, the RO/5T.N1 was a docile, automated [[gardener droid]]. They were programmed to be intelligent, however this intelligence was focused solely<ref name="EGTD" /> on tending botanical areas<ref name="FF35" /> as well as gardening and cultivation techniques. RO/5T.N1 units had a database of over one million [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and the droid was fully capable of nuturing their charges<ref name="EGTD" /> by assessing their condition and providing necessary care. This care ranged from laying down mulch bedding that could suppress the growth of weeds and providing the top soil with fertilizer, to implementing a pollination program in an environment that had an absence of local [[Insect/Legends|insects]].<ref name="FF35" />

The droids paid little attention to anything outside their scope of responsibilities,<ref name="EGTD" /> and were programmed to take pride in their work. However this would often manifest as irritation and lack of social graces, especially if a plant under their charge was damaged. RO/5T.N1s had been known to become irate if they perceived an organic was being careless<ref name="FF35" /> such as leaving a flagstone path and stepping onto their freshly cut [[Grass/Legends|grass]], or if they picked a blossoming [[T'iil]] [[Flower/Legends|flower]].<ref name="EGTD" />

==History==
[[Publictechnic]] was a relatively new droid manufacturer when they designed and released the RO/5T.N1 as one of their first forays into the market.<ref name="FF35" /> The droid was first introduced several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and went through several models with one of the latest being serial-stamped as the RO/5T.N1, commonly referred to simply as the 5T Tree Feeder. The company marketed the RO/5T.N1 to government, municipal, and corporate entities, selling the droids in lots of no less than fifty units. Private buyers such as growers and landscapers therefore found it difficult to purchase the droids, and were forced to find individual tree feeders for sale at used-droid lots.<ref name="EGTD" />

RO/5T.N1 droids were common sights on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] with beautifully manicured landscaping such as [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] and [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]]. They were also found on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in the [[Plawal Rift]] region where they were used to harvest the [[shalaman]] and [[podon]] orchards by the local [[Mluki]] government. [[Irek Ismaren]] would test his [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities by influencing the droids to break their programming and run wild.<ref name="EGTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The model number '''RO/5T.N1''' is a reference to editor [[Sue Rostoni]], who is also a gardener.<ref name="Dan">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2007/06/forgotten-easter-eggs-im-not-huge-fan.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Forgotten Easter Eggs}}</ref>
